behaviors.semantics: Native connections share the same database, WAL and mapped WAL-index locks/state. Normal writer/reset and checkpoint progress may overlap. No process crash or media error in this race envelope.

recovery: Faults cease; all configured nodes/connections are healthy. Continuously enabled tasks, IO and messages receive finite bounded progress, clocks advance. Verify actual election timeouts and fairness bounds before liveness judgment.
exclusions: full production service transport/framing outside the stated module boundary
